output_list.code: function PolyAi(uint256 initialSupply, string tokenName, uint8 decimalUnits, string tokenSymbol) token (initialSupply, tokenName, decimalUnits, tokenSymbol) {}
output_list.reason: In this case, the function is a constructor. The constructor is vulnerable to poor randomness as it relies on the blockhash of the block. The blockhash is determined by the hash of the entire block, including all transactions in it. This can potentially be exploited to predict the outcome of certain game or lotteries for free. The attacker can send the same transaction again, and get different outcome.
